verdict.rationale: Braintrust has some event-driven automation: online scoring runs scorers on production traces as they are logged, and Patterns runs Loop analysis over traces on a schedule. Monitoring can also be configured through the MCP server. However, nothing documents a general rules engine where users set conditions and attach actions such as alerts, webhooks or workflow steps. CI/CD eval runs depend on external pipelines. Missing for 10: user-defined condition→action rules, configurable action types (alerts, webhooks, notifications), documentation of how automation rules are set up, independent or hands-on corroboration.
